description: Operator reports a job's status (in_progress, completed, failed). Requires operate authority for the stored job's kernel: its recorded operator identity (the caller that registered it), its proven operator wallet, or the gateway admin authority. The body's kernelId cannot choose the authorization target. Another identity gets 403; no credentials gets 401 before the job read; a job without a kernel gets 403 for a non-admin. Operator identity proof for operate is completed by WP-A (DECISIONS items 136 and 138). The node path finishes a job in two calls: submit its evidence (POST /api/operator/evidence, posted with the kernel's proven operator wallet authority, decide), and only if that receipt says stored: true for this jobId, set status completed here. HTTP 200 alone is not enough: the relay answers 200 with stored: false when it could not store the evidence (an unknown job, a storage failure); then set failed with the reason evidence_not_stored. On the current gateway, completed marks the job done and its timeline then says settled, but the escrow is not released yet (board G1). Do not call pcc_job_complete after this: it answers 409.
name: operator_update_job_status
